data.title: ULK1.ATG13.FIP200 complex mediates mTOR signaling and is essential for autophagy
data.authors: Ganley IG; Lam DH; Wang J; Ding X; Chen S; Jiang X

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.finding: The ULK1-ATG13-FIP200 complex transmits mTOR signalling to initiate autophagy.
data.abstract_excerpt: Autophagy is a degradative process that recycles long-lived and faulty cellular components. It is linked to many diseases and is required for normal development. ULK1, a mammalian serine/threonine protein kinase, plays a key role in the initial stages of autophagy, though the exact molecular mechanism is unknown. Here we report identification of a novel protein complex containing ULK1 and two additional protein factors, FIP200 and ATG13, all of which are essential for starvation-induced autophagy.
